# Barn 1.0.0

Released on 2026-11-04. Barn 1.0.0 is the first stable release: it is published
on GitHub's regular release channel, so `releases/latest`, the download
installer without `BARN_VERSION`, and the Homebrew formula select it.

Barn 1.0.0 freezes the command-line contract that 0.9.x converged on and
finishes a pre-release audit of destructive operations, data-disk recovery,
catalog integrity, and process cancellation. It embeds the same signed image
catalog revision `2026102802` as 0.9.3.

## Changes

- **Safer whole-deployment recreate.** A `recreate` without node selectors
  refuses an inventory that no longer lists an existing node (`conflict`,
  reason `nodes_removed`, exit 4) before any VM stops; earlier releases
  destroyed the omitted node without recreating it. Remove a node explicitly
  with `barn destroy NODE` or add it back to the inventory. The confirmation
  lists every node the operation replaces, and the scope is checked again
  under the destruction lock (`deployment_changed` when the applied state
  changed during preflight).
- **Destroying the control node keeps the lab usable.** The first remaining
  node becomes the control node, with a consistent state, so `ssh-config`,
  `hosts`, `exec`, and `provision` keep working. Update the inventory's control
  role, then run `barn up` to install its control SSH access. Barn refuses to
  destroy the control node, before deleting anything, when the successor has an
  unfinished prepare record that cannot be completed.
- **Data disks are reset only on recognized corruption.** Disks with a
  partition table, a signature without a UUID, unsupported filesystem
  features, or an unknown checker failure keep their data and report a
  warning. An ext4 or XFS filesystem is reset only after the checker reports
  recognized corruption. Existing guests receive the updated helper on their
  next `barn up` readiness check.
- **Confirmations.**
  - On a terminal, `up`, `start`, `restart`, and `reload` show the
    host-preparation plan and ask once before installing packages or the Barn
    network, as `barn setup` does. Without a terminal they still only report
    what is missing; run `barn setup --yes` for unattended preparation.
  - On a terminal, `barn purge` lists its scope and asks you to type `purge`.
    `--yes` (or `--force`) skips the question. Without a terminal it runs
    without a prompt, as before.
  - `destroy`, `recreate`, `mac destroy`, and `mac recreate` accept `--yes` as
    their confirmation flag. `--force` keeps working, and `mac stop --force`
    still powers the VM off.
- **Catalog integrity has its own exit code.** A catalog signature or signed
  revision that does not verify exits 7 (`integrity`, reason
  `catalog_signature` or `catalog_equivocation`) instead of 1. Permission and
  I/O errors on a cached signature remain runtime failures (exit 1). Both
  official repositories share the embedded upgrade baseline, a new trusted
  signature over identical catalog bytes is accepted, and catalog commands keep
  working after `barn image reset` on an earlier version followed by an
  upgrade.
- **Cancellation reaches `sudo`.** Cancelled commands receive SIGTERM, which
  `sudo` forwards, and Barn waits at most 10 seconds for the process and its
  inherited pipes. Descendants that ignore SIGTERM still need external
  supervision.
- **Host networking and Mac images.** `barn network uninstall` keeps the
  global networkd unit state when other host links exist or exclusive Barn use
  cannot be established; the plan reports `preserve_networkd` and the applied
  report explains the decision in `checks.networkd`. Mac image pruning keeps
  bases referenced by interrupted recreates; a malformed recovery journal stops
  the cleanup until its references are known.
- **CLI.**
  - Running `barn` without a command prints the complete help, as
    `barn --help` does; `--json` and `--yaml` keep the `actions[]` document.
  - Explicit `--json`/`--yaml` and `--verbose` override `BARN_OUTPUT` and
    `BARN_VERBOSE`, and help stays available when those variables are invalid.
- **Dependencies.** Go 1.27.3, `golang.org/x/net` 0.62.0, and
  `go.yaml.in/yaml/v3` 3.0.6.

## Compatibility

From 1.0.0, incompatible changes to the following require a new major version:

- command names, aliases, flags, and argument grammar, including `--` before a
  remote command;
- exit codes and the structured `error` and `reason` values;
- existing fields of `--json` and `--yaml` output (new fields may be added);
- the inventory format and the meaning of existing `vm_*` keys;
- `BARN_*` environment variables;
- deployment and Mac state under `BARN_HOME`: a 1.x release reads the state of
  earlier 1.x releases and of 0.9.3 without recreating VMs.

Human-readable text, help wording, progress lines, and log contents may change
in any release. Scripts should use `--json` or `--yaml` and exit codes.

Two behaviors that scripts sometimes misread stay as they are in 1.x:

- Without `--yes`, `network` and `hosts` `install`/`uninstall` only print the
  plan and exit 0 when stdin is not a terminal or the output is `--json` or
  `--yaml`. Check `applied` in the structured output, or pass `--yes`.
- `destroy` and `recreate` without node arguments apply to the whole
  deployment.

## Upgrade

The installer selects the latest stable release, verifies the archive against
the release's `checksums.txt`, and installs into `~/.local/bin` without sudo:

```bash
curl -fLO https://github.com/pgsty/barn/releases/latest/download/install.sh
bash install.sh
```

Set `BARN_VERSION=1.0.0` to pin this release. On macOS, run
`brew upgrade barn` (or `brew install pgsty/infra/barn`). On Linux, install the
DEB or RPM package from the release.

Upgrading from 0.9.3 requires no recreation; VM disks, SSH keys, state, and
configuration stay under `~/.barn`. Stop macOS VMs before replacing the native
component. Check scripts for these changes:

- catalog signature failures now exit 7 instead of 1;
- a whole-deployment `recreate` exits 4 when the inventory omits an existing
  node;
- interactive `up` asks before preparing the host;
- `purge` asks on a terminal.

The Apple Silicon archive and Homebrew installation include the signed,
notarized `Barn.app`, CLI, and hosts helper. Linux arm64/amd64 and Intel macOS
provide the CLI and hosts helper; Linux guests use QEMU.

## Known limitations

- A malformed Mac recovery journal stops `barn mac image ls`, the space
  estimate in `barn mac doctor`, and image pruning until it is repaired.
- One unreadable Mac machine state stops listing all machines; machines are
  still usable by name.
- Linux guest shares on macOS hosts need a guest kernel with 9p support.

## Support

Security fixes land in the latest 1.x patch release. 0.x releases receive no
further fixes; upgrade to 1.0.0. See
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/pgsty/barn/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

See the [installation guide](https://barn.pgsty.com/docs/start/installation/),
the [Linux quick start](https://barn.pgsty.com/docs/start/tutorial/), and the
[Mac guide](https://barn.pgsty.com/docs/start/macos/).

# Barn 1.0.0（中文）

发布日期：2026-11-04。Barn 1.0.0 是首个稳定版，通过 GitHub 正式发布频道发布。
`releases/latest`、不带 `BARN_VERSION` 的下载安装器与 Homebrew 配方都会选择此版本。

Barn 1.0.0 固定了 0.9.x 逐步收敛的命令行契约，并完成发布前对破坏性操作、数据盘恢复、
目录完整性与进程取消的审计。本版内置与 0.9.3 相同的签名镜像目录 revision `2026102802`。

## 变更

- **整套部署重建更安全。** 不带节点参数的 `recreate` 遇到清单缺少已有节点时，会在停止
  任何虚拟机前拒绝执行（`conflict`，reason `nodes_removed`，退出码 4）；此前版本会删除
  被省略的节点却不重建。需要删除节点时请显式执行 `barn destroy NODE`，否则把它加回清单。
  确认提示会列出本次替换的每个节点；销毁锁内会再次核对范围，预检期间已应用状态发生变化时
  返回 `deployment_changed`。
- **删除控制节点后环境仍可用。** 剩余的第一个节点接任控制节点，状态保持一致，
  `ssh-config`、`hosts`、`exec` 与 `provision` 可继续使用。请先在清单中更新控制角色，
  再执行 `barn up` 安装其控制 SSH 访问。接任节点存在无法完成的准备记录时，Barn 会在
  删除任何内容前拒绝删除控制节点。
- **只在识别出损坏时重置数据盘。** 带分区表、签名缺少 UUID、使用不支持的文件系统特性
  或检查工具未知失败的磁盘会保留数据并给出警告。ext4 或 XFS 只有在检查工具报告可识别的
  损坏时才会重置。已有客机会在下一次 `barn up` 的就绪检查中获得更新后的脚本。
- **确认流程。**
  - 在终端中，`up`、`start`、`restart` 与 `reload` 安装软件包或 Barn 网络前，会像
    `barn setup` 一样展示宿主准备计划并询问一次。没有终端时仍只报告缺少的条件；无人值守
    准备请执行 `barn setup --yes`。
  - 在终端中，`barn purge` 会列出清理范围并要求输入 `purge`，`--yes`（或 `--force`）
    跳过询问。没有终端时与之前一样直接执行。
  - `destroy`、`recreate`、`mac destroy` 与 `mac recreate` 接受 `--yes` 作为确认参数。
    `--force` 继续有效；`mac stop --force` 仍表示强制断电。
- **目录完整性使用独立退出码。** 目录签名或签名 revision 校验失败时退出 7
  （`integrity`，reason 为 `catalog_signature` 或 `catalog_equivocation`），不再是 1。
  缓存签名的权限或 I/O 错误仍属于运行时错误（退出 1）。两个官方仓库共享内置升级基线；
  对相同目录字节的新可信签名会被接受；在旧版本执行 `barn image reset` 后再升级，目录命令
  仍可正常使用。
- **取消操作可以传递给 `sudo`。** 被取消的命令会收到 SIGTERM，`sudo` 会将其转发；Barn
  最多等待 10 秒让进程及其继承的管道结束。忽略 SIGTERM 的后代进程仍需外部监管。
- **宿主网络与 Mac 镜像。** 存在其他宿主网络接口或无法确认由 Barn 独占时，
  `barn network uninstall` 会保留全局 networkd 单元状态；计划中报告 `preserve_networkd`，
  执行结果在 `checks.networkd` 中说明原因。Mac 镜像清理会保留中断的重建仍引用的 base；
  恢复日志损坏时，清理会停止，直到确认其引用。
- **命令行。**
  - 不带命令运行 `barn` 会输出与 `barn --help` 相同的完整帮助；`--json` 与 `--yaml`
    仍返回 `actions[]` 文档。
  - 显式的 `--json`/`--yaml` 与 `--verbose` 优先于 `BARN_OUTPUT` 和 `BARN_VERBOSE`；
    这些变量取值无效时仍可查看帮助。
- **依赖。** Go 1.27.3、`golang.org/x/net` 0.62.0、`go.yaml.in/yaml/v3` 3.0.6。

## 兼容性

自 1.0.0 起，以下内容的不兼容变更需要提升主版本号：

- 命令名、别名、参数与参数语法，包括远程命令前的 `--`；
- 退出码以及结构化输出中的 `error`、`reason` 取值；
- `--json` 与 `--yaml` 输出的已有字段（可以新增字段）；
- 清单格式以及已有 `vm_*` 键的含义；
- `BARN_*` 环境变量；
- `BARN_HOME` 下的部署状态与 Mac 状态：1.x 版本能读取更早的 1.x 及 0.9.3 写入的状态，
  无需重建虚拟机。

面向人阅读的文本、帮助措辞、进度行与日志内容可能在任何版本中变化。脚本请使用 `--json`
或 `--yaml` 以及退出码。

以下两项容易被脚本误读的行为在 1.x 中保持不变：

- 未传 `--yes` 时，如果标准输入不是终端或输出为 `--json`/`--yaml`，`network` 与 `hosts`
  的 `install`/`uninstall` 只输出计划并退出 0。请检查结构化输出中的 `applied`，或传入
  `--yes`。
- 不带节点参数的 `destroy` 与 `recreate` 作用于整套部署。

## 升级

安装器会选择最新稳定版，按该版本的 `checksums.txt` 校验归档，并在不使用 sudo 的情况下
安装到 `~/.local/bin`：

```bash
curl -fLO https://github.com/pgsty/barn/releases/latest/download/install.sh
bash install.sh
```

需要固定本版本时设置 `BARN_VERSION=1.0.0`。macOS 上执行 `brew upgrade barn`
（或 `brew install pgsty/infra/barn`）；Linux 上可安装发布页中的 DEB 或 RPM 软件包。

从 0.9.3 升级无需重建；虚拟机磁盘、SSH 密钥、状态与配置仍保存在 `~/.barn`。替换原生组件前
请先停止 macOS 虚拟机。请检查脚本是否受以下变化影响：

- 目录签名校验失败时退出码由 1 变为 7；
- 清单缺少已有节点时，整套部署 `recreate` 退出 4；
- 交互式 `up` 准备宿主前会询问；
- 在终端中执行 `purge` 会要求确认。

Apple Silicon 归档与 Homebrew 安装包含签名并经 Apple 公证的 `Barn.app`、CLI 与
hosts helper。Linux arm64/amd64 与 Intel Mac 提供 CLI 和 hosts helper；Linux 客机使用 QEMU。

## 已知限制

- Mac 恢复日志损坏时，`barn mac image ls`、`barn mac doctor` 的空间估算与镜像清理会失败，
  直到日志修复。
- 单个 Mac 机器状态无法读取时，机器列表会整体失败；按名称操作其他机器不受影响。
- 在 macOS 宿主上为 Linux 客机挂载共享目录，需要客机内核支持 9p。

## 支持

安全修复发布在最新的 1.x 补丁版本中。0.x 版本不再提供修复，请升级到 1.0.0。详见
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/pgsty/barn/blob/main/SECURITY.md)。

详见[安装指南](https://barn.pgsty.com/zh/docs/start/installation/)、
[Linux 快速上手](https://barn.pgsty.com/zh/docs/start/tutorial/)与
[Mac 指南](https://barn.pgsty.com/zh/docs/start/macos/)。
